You are signed in, but the encrypted vault is locked on this device. Verify your Kitsugi password to unlock it. Search history and notification archive sync work independently; add-on lists and linked-account backup need the vault unlocked.

Only enabled categories are synced. Search history and notifications are protected by account-specific server access rules, not end-to-end encryption. Linked-account tokens, portable settings, and add-on lists are stored in the encrypted vault. Add-on files are never uploaded.
